description: Which notes locale to use. Inputs: the user's preferred locales in order and the locales a notes file has. For each preferred locale, try it, then drop trailing subtags one by one (pt-BR -> pt, zh-Hant-TW -> zh-Hant -> zh); after all preferred locales, try en. Matching is ASCII case-insensitive and treats _ like -. The result is the available key as spelled in the file, or null when nothing matches.

cases.name: script and region are dropped one at a time
earlier preferred locale wins even via fallback
case and underscore are ignored, key returned as spelled
language request does not pick a regional variant
